text:
Eastern Illinois University opens season ticket sales for fall sports and basketball
K. R. Stuart
Season tickets for Eastern Illinois University athletics are now available to renew and purchase, according to a June 3 announcement. The offer includes football, volleyball, and men's and women's basketball for the upcoming seasons.
Football season tickets are priced at $90 per person, with a youth option available for $40. Each ticket provides a reserved seat in Sections D and E at O'Brien Field for five home games, beginning with the opener against Indiana State on September 12. Season ticket holders will also receive a coupon for a free hot dog and drink at each game.
For volleyball fans, reserved chairback seats can be purchased for $50 at Gardella Family Court at McAfee Gym. This seating provides access to all home matches as Eastern Illinois University seeks to defend its 2025 Ohio Valley Conference Championship. The 2026 schedule includes preseason action, conference contests, and matches against teams from Power Four Conferences such as Illinois and Notre Dame. Free admission is offered for non-reserved chairback seats.
Men's and women's basketball season tickets are also available ahead of the early November opening in Groniger Arena. Reserved chairback seats cost $180 per seat; general admission season tickets are priced at $105, with faculty and staff eligible for a discounted rate of $90.
Season tickets can be renewed or purchased online or by calling the university's athletics office.
